description: Send a generic plain-text message into an existing OpenTrain conversation the token owner participates in. This generic tool is intentionally outside shared Job Operations synchronization. When managing a job, do NOT use this tool: claim the shared action, re-read root and thread messages, and use opentrain_send_managed_job_message instead. Target with conversationId or prefer contractId for canonical Job Message resolution. Requires messages:write. Supply a stable idempotencyKey before the first attempt. After a timeout or unknown outcome, retry only that same key, target and original content; without a key, read before retrying. A saved message or content-integrity check is not proof of email delivery. Optional videoAssetId attaches one READY same-org video atomically to a job message; requires videos:read, message_video_references, and the video_library agent-surface family (otherwise a typed refusal). No proposal DMs. Retry with the same asset and payload.
name: opentrain_send_message
